STATUS LOGIC / DEMO

Thresholds that matter.

Temperature and battery limits determine the status displayed in this demo.

CRITICALTemperature ≥ 50°C or SOC ≤ 8%
WARNINGTemperature ≥ 44°C or SOC ≤ 20% or SOH < 75%
CHARGINGCharging flag active with no higher threshold
NORMALNo warning or critical condition
Illustrative thresholds — calibrate and validate before hardware use.
